title: Equivariant cell-colour block refinement with exact finite generator intertwining
proposed_by: TECT research programme under operator directive

parent.composition_rule: This is a separately versioned structural successor. It supplements, but does not edit or supersede, PAH-001 or PAH-OMC-001. Every theorem is about the explicitly composed candidate and is not retroactive evidence for either parent.

exact_scope.coarse_carrier: Any finite PAH-OMC-001 completed anchored relational carrier G with finite fixed-Q state space Omega_(rho,Q).
exact_scope.refinement_family: For level n>=0 set q_n=2^n, retain the same coarse carrier and attach one colour in Z_(q_n) to each of a fixed finite list of local cells. The refined state is Omega_n=Omega_(rho,Q) x (Z_(q_n))^C. The family is a structural fibre/block refinement, not a geometric subdivision or physical lattice.
exact_scope.coarse_map: p_n:Omega_n->Omega_(rho,Q) forgets all cell colours. It is surjective and preserves every parent coordinate, anchor, orientation and fixed-Q sector.
exact_scope.regulator: The PAH tuple rho=(G,O,C,K,M_s,M_psi,R_max,epsilon,a,beta,nu,theta,Q) is transported identically. The refinement label is a_n=a_0/2^n only as a formal label; it is not a physical length.
exact_scope.functional: Write the unchanged parent F_rho as a finite sum of local terms F_rho(x)=sum_t Phi_t(x). Define F_n(x,h)=sum_t sum_(j=0)^(q_n-1) (1/q_n) Phi_t(x). No hidden colour enters Phi_t and no energy, counterterm or coupling is added, so F_n=F_rho exactly.
exact_scope.time: External stochastic Markov time only; the construction does not identify Markov time with quantum, proper or Lorentzian time.
exact_scope.limits: The audit covers finitely many levels and takes no cutoff, volume, continuum, physical or observation limit.

cell_weights_and_parameter_transport.cell_set: A fixed finite labelled cell list C; the audit fixture uses two cells c0,c1 only as a finite test input.
cell_weights_and_parameter_transport.weights: w_(n,j)=1/q_n for j in {0,...,q_n-1}; sum_j w_(n,j)=1 exactly at every level.

parameters.a: a_n=a_0/2^n as a refinement label only
parameters.couplings: Every scalar, edge, plaquette, onsite, aperture and rate-scale input is inherited identically from PAH-001 and PAH-OMC-001.

cell_weights_and_parameter_transport.error_contract: Use the common sup norm ||g||_infinity=sup_(x,h)|g(x,h)| on lifted bounded cylinder observables. The exact target is delta_n(f)=||L_n I_n f-I_n L_rho f||_infinity=0. For a future approximate successor, admissibility requires a preregistered parameter range and sum_(n=0)^N delta_n(f)<=eta for every N with a finite eta; no such approximate claim is made here.

symmetry_and_root_cocycle.colour_fibre: H_n=(Z_(q_n))^C with coordinate-wise addition modulo q_n.
symmetry_and_root_cocycle.retained_root_lift: For every parent directed root r with parent map r.x, choose a labelled local cocycle tau_(n,r):H_n->H_n. Define r_n(x,h)=(r.x,tau_(n,r)(h)).
symmetry_and_root_cocycle.inverse_rule: tau_(n,r^(-1))=tau_(n,r)^(-1), so every lifted parent root is inverse-closed and retains parent channel multiplicity.
symmetry_and_root_cocycle.gauge_action: The parent gauge action acts on x and trivially on H_n; root labels and cocycles are gauge-equivariant.
symmetry_and_root_cocycle.anchor_automorphism: An allowed parent anchor automorphism acts on x, permutes the labelled cells and sends r to h.r. Require h tau_(n,r)=tau_(n,h.r) h.
symmetry_and_root_cocycle.rate_rule: The lifted root rate is c_(n,r)(x,h)=c_r(x), where c_r is the exact parent PAH-OMC-001 rate computed from the unchanged F_rho and mobility.

observable_and_generator_targets.lift: (I_n f)(x,h)=f(x). The common cylinder core is the union of these lifts for parent gauge- and anchor-automorphism-invariant bounded observables f.
observable_and_generator_targets.exact_generator_identity: L_n I_n f=I_n L_rho f pointwise on Omega_n for every f in the declared core, because p_n r_n=r p_n and c_(n,r)=c_r.
observable_and_generator_targets.semigroup_identity: At each finite level, T_n(t) I_n=I_n T_rho(t) follows algebraically from the generator identity for the finite exponential; it is not a common infinite-volume dynamics theorem.
observable_and_generator_targets.norm_and_cumulative: The exact defect is zero for every level, hence sup_n delta_n(f)=0 and every finite cumulative defect sum is zero. No n->infinity limit is inferred.

finite_acceptance_conditions: The PAH-001 and PAH-OMC-001 parent hashes match exactly and neither parent is edited.
q_n=2^n, the fibre map p_n is total and surjective, and every cell-weight row is normalized.
F_n=F_rho exactly by normalized local-term replication; no hidden energy or counterterm is present.
Every retained root has the declared inverse cocycle, preserves p_n, and retains parent multiplicity.
Gauge and anchor automorphisms preserve the fibre map, cocycle, functional and rate.
The exact generator identity is checked on the full finite parent function basis, hence on the invariant cylinder core, with zero common sup-norm defect.
Primary, non-importing independent, hostile and Lean checks agree; no physical or continuum promotion is allowed.

known_boundaries.structural_not_geometric: The colour fibre increases finite state cardinality and supplies a local root cocycle, but it is not a cell subdivision with new geometric incidence, a physical lattice, or a continuum approximation.
known_boundaries.not_free_vertex: No fine vertex is added and no natural free-vertex forgetful pullback is used; the R-479/R-480 route-local defects are not reused or erased.
known_boundaries.not_scalar_repair: No positive scalar beta or kappa transport and no post-hoc rate rescaling is used.
known_boundaries.not_gibbs_average: The map is a deterministic pullback lift, not the rejected PAH-OMC-002 conditional-Gibbs fibre average.
known_boundaries.successor_only: The theorem is for PAH-001 composed with PAH-OMC-001 and this separately hashed PAH-OMC-003 structural successor; it is not a theorem about PAH-001 alone.

falsifiers: A parent hash changes or a parent byte is modified.
A cell-weight row does not sum to one or p_n is not total and surjective.
F_n differs from F_rho, or a hidden energy/counterterm is silently inserted.
A lifted root loses an inverse, changes a parent channel multiplicity, or fails p_n r_n=r p_n.
A gauge or anchor automorphism fails the cocycle or rate equivariance test.
The exact generator defect is nonzero on any finite parent basis observable.
Any report promotes the structural finite result to a geometric refinement, uniform continuum, physical Pre-A, QFT, gravity, Yang--Mills or TOE theorem.
non_claims: PAH-OMC-003 is a researcher-proposed structural hypothesis, not an external source or physical authority.
No PAH-001 or PAH-OMC-001 byte, functional, parent move family, projection, regulator rule or limit order is changed.
The exact result is finite and structural; it does not prove a geometric lattice refinement, a uniform infinite-volume estimate or an ordered limit.
No Markov time is identified with quantum real time, proper time or Lorentzian time.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, event horizon, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, continuum, mass gap, cosmic-origin or TOE conclusion follows.
Agreement between the coarse and refined observables is a compatibility theorem, not an observational fit or a physical identification.
single_next_question: Can a separately owner-approved geometric subdivision, with nontrivial incidence transport beyond a colour fibre, satisfy the same exact or cumulatively controlled common-core intertwining without changing PAH-001?
revisit_condition: Reopen a geometric or uniform-limit route only after a new separately hashed owner contract supplies incidence transport, parameter and cell-weight laws, a common core, a common norm and an independent uniform estimate.
stop_or_redesign: Do not call this structural fibre theorem a geometric lattice refinement or continuum result.
Do not edit PAH-001, PAH-OMC-001 or the failed PAH-OMC-002 route to obtain the identity.
If nonzero defect appears, record its first exact witness and keep the successor unadmitted.
If geometric incidence or new physical terms are required, create a new successor contract and restart finite auditing.
